summary: Allows users to view day-wise or monthly-wise collection amounts categorized by fee head and payment mode.
navigation: Fees > Fee Reports > Fee Head Collection Report
steps: Select the desired date range (e.g., today, a specific month).
Optionally, select a "mode" to differentiate collection by payment mode (e.g., cash, online, amount adjust).
The report will display collection amounts per fee head (e.g., admission fee, tuition fee, miscellaneous) for the selected period and mode.
business_rules: "Amount adjust" refers to amounts collected in one fee head but later adjusted to another.
important_notes: This report helps analyze collection trends per fee head and payment method.
questions: How can I see the collection amounts per fee head?
Can I view fee head collection day-wise or month-wise?
What does "amount adjust" mean in the fee head collection report?
